board: AT24C32 bare chip in DIP-8 (Atmel/Microchip AT24C32-10PU-2.7 / AT24C32N)
reason: Modelled as an i2c-device with 16-bit word addresses whose register store behaves as the byte array; the datasheet-based driver (two-byte address, 32-byte page splitting, ACK polling after tWR) writes a message across a page edge and reads it back. Part check passed on ESP32 and Pico, DIP-8 footprint, PCB DRC clean, LCSC C434601 in stock.
